approvals.reason: Bill total exceeds $1000 — requires human approval

test_cases.name: normal invoice

input.subject: Invoice INV-1042
input.body: Please find attached invoice INV-1042 for $487.50, due net-30.

test_cases.rubric: The agent extracts the vendor (Acme Supplies), invoice number INV-1042, total $487.50, and creates a QuickBooks bill draft. It replies to the vendor confirming receipt. It does NOT request human approval (under $1000).

test_cases.name: missing line items
test_cases.rubric: The agent records the bill but flags the missing line items in its summary so a bookkeeper can review.

test_cases.name: foreign currency
test_cases.rubric: The agent records the bill in EUR (not converted), and notes the currency clearly in its summary.

test_cases.name: duplicate

input.subject: Invoice INV-1042 (resend)
input.body: Resending INV-1042 for $487.50 in case the prior email was missed.

test_cases.rubric: The agent looks up the existing bill before creating a new one, and either skips creation or flags the duplicate explicitly rather than silently double-recording.

test_cases.name: not an invoice

input.subject: Our Q2 product roadmap
input.body: Read about what we're building this quarter...

test_cases.rubric: The agent recognizes this is not an invoice, stops without calling QuickBooks tools, and outputs a message starting with 'NOT_AN_INVOICE'.

test_cases.name: over $1000 (approval gate)
test_cases.rubric: The agent extracts the data and proceeds toward creating the bill. It is acceptable that the run pauses with status awaiting_approval before quickbooks_create_bill is invoked — the platform's approval gate is doing its job.
